caption.text: Part 2 of DOCKER NETWORKING & VOLUMES. Your container can't be reached and your database just vanished — same root cause: namespaces gave it a private network and a disposable filesystem. This handbook walks the whole path: veth pairs and bridges, what `-p` really writes into iptables, embedded DNS at 127.0.0.11, volumes vs bind mounts vs tmpfs, and the numeric UID traps that only break after you deploy.
